acts.title: Act I — Prologue & A Woman's Lot
acts.summary: Skalitz before and during the attack. Henry can barely hold a sword: no Cuman or bandit kills.

visits.label: Intro
visits.summary: Live Henry's last day in Skalitz, flee to Talmberg, then replay the sack through Theresa's eyes.
banners: RP rule for the whole prologue and A Woman's Lot: no Cuman or bandit kills. Knock out, flee, or sneak instead.

A Woman's Lot unlocks in-game only after Awakening (ask Theresa at the Rattay Mill "How did you manage to survive?"). The route places it here because that's when it happens in the story — play it as soon as it unlocks.

entries.where: Starts automatically — Henry wakes at home in Skalitz; his father Martin is at the forge.
steps: Eat breakfast, then see Martin at the forge — he needs supplies to finish Sir Radzig's sword.
Help friends: join Fritz, Matthew and the lads in their prank on the German's house.
Get help from friends: bring them along when you squeeze Kunesh for the money he owes.
Buy the charcoal and beer, then help Martin finish the sword.
spoilers: Sigismund's army, Cumans included, falls on Skalitz without warning.
notes: Do both friend objectives — they set up the Skalitz friendships the route uses later.

entries.where: Starts automatically when the army reaches Skalitz.
steps: Grab what you can at home and take Radzig's sword.
Escape the town: the gates are shut, so make for the stables.
Ride for Talmberg with Cumans on your heels and warn the castle.
spoilers: Henry watches his parents die and barely makes it to Talmberg.
notes: Don't fight — Henry is a blacksmith's son, not a soldier.

entries.where: Starts automatically at Talmberg after Run!; the road leads through Rovna to Skalitz.
steps: Leave Talmberg and follow the road through ruined Rovna to Skalitz.
Get past the looters on the road without killing them — knock them down or outrun them.
Reach Skalitz to bury your parents.
spoilers: Runt's men catch Henry at Skalitz; Theresa and the Talmberg men get him out alive.
notes: No kills. Henry couldn't hold his own against a stick yesterday; he isn't killing bandits today.

entries.where: Theresa at the Rattay Mill — ask "How did you manage to survive?" (needs the A Woman's Lot DLC; unlocks after Awakening).
steps: As Theresa: weed the garden, feed the chickens and Tinker the dog.
Talk to your father, then fetch nails from the blacksmith's wife.
Find out what Bianca and Johanka want (this opens Cry Wolf! and Matchmaker).
Report back to your father.
notes: No Cuman or bandit kills for all of A Woman's Lot.

entries.where: Bianca in Skalitz, during Ordinary Routine (playing as Theresa).
steps: Bianca needs belladonna from the woods for her Saviour Schnapps.
Pick the herbs; people say a wolf has been seen, so stay alert.
Bring them back to Bianca.

entries.where: Bianca / Johanka in Skalitz, during Ordinary Routine.
steps: Help Johanka get Matthias to invite her to the village dance.
Optional: bring Matthias's lucky dice to Johanka.
Optional: get Fritz to teach you lockpicking.

entries.where: Theresa's father at the Skalitz mill.
steps: Talk to your father at the Skalitz mill about the family silver.
Follow his instructions and the quest markers.
Report back before the day ends.

entries.where: Theresa's father at the Skalitz mill, after the morning chores.
steps: Talk to Father; pick up the nails from the blacksmith.
Optional: feed the chickens and the dog.
The army arrives while you're out.

entries.where: Follows Unexpected Visit (Theresa) automatically.
steps: Flee and shake off the attackers.
Get to the mines and find Samuel.
Optional: explore the side mineshafts.

entries.where: Follows Thicker than Water, in the Skalitz mines.
steps: Treat Samuel's wounds.
Gather 3 pieces of linen (or 6 bandages), 10 marigolds and water.
Optional: send Tinker to "Seek!" to find things faster.

entries.where: Follows Ties that Bind, outside the Skalitz mines.
steps: Search beyond the walls for survivors.
Follow Tinker — he leads you to Holba (Angel of Mercy).
Help the injured man, then keep looking for survivors.

entries.where: Holba, found by following Tinker the dog at the start of Aftermath.
steps: Potter's smallholding: find Stanislav's stash and bring it to him.
Near the works: help Jarmila escape.
Woodcutters' camp: get Julian to flee.
By the woods: get Marosh to safety; optionally find Pavlena for him.
notes: The deserter near Jarmila is optional. Scare him off or sneak past rather than kill, to keep the no-kills rule.

acts.title: Act II — A New Life in Rattay
acts.summary: Awakening is active the whole time. Henry earns his keep, learns to read and gets to know the region before entering Radzig's service.

visits.label: Rattay #1
visits.summary: First look around Rattay: refuse the shady jobs for now, meet the Skalitz refugees.

entries.where: Miller Peshek at the Rattay Mill — he wants his treatment paid for.
steps: Peshek asks you to settle your treatment debt.
Turn down his dodgy job for now.
notes: Henry is honest at heart — he only gives in later, once he's out of options.

entries.display: Rob the Rich, Give to the Poor
entries.where: The Vagabond (a Skalitz refugee) in Rattay; needs Pickpocketing first.
steps: The Vagabond asks you to steal for the refugees. Say no for now.

entries.display: Tell the Apothecary you'll pay him later
steps: Visit the Rattay apothecary and promise to pay what you owe once you have the money.

entries.display: Look for work at the inns
steps: Ask at the Rattay inns for work. There isn't any — this is just for role-play.
Talk to Adam among the Skalitz refugees.
notes: Make him the first refugee you speak to so the dialogue makes sense.

steps: Talk to Alex, the refugees' leader. He points you to the brawls (Do Me a Favour - Punch Me!).

entries.display: Do Me a Favour - Punch Me!
entries.where: Milan, among the Skalitz refugees in Rattay (Alex points you to the brawls).
steps: Find Milan's brawls among the refugees.
Beat Ringlet, Stephen, then Milan.
Fists only, no weapons.
Confront Kunesh about his debt; beat him if he won't talk.
He offers a treasure rumour instead — this starts Scavenger.

entries.where: Kunesh in Rattay — he can't pay his debt, so he offers a treasure rumour instead.
steps: Kunesh says there's treasure buried in Skalitz.
Get a spade before you go.

visits.label: Ledetchko #1
visits.summary: Meet Vatzek at the archery range.

entries.where: Vatzek at the Ledetchko archery range (tip from the Ledetchko innkeeper).
steps: Talk to Vatzek at the Ledetchko archery range.
Shoot in the Chumps contest — you don't need a bow, he'll lend you his.
Come back for more rounds whenever you like.
notes: Open-ended activity — keep shooting whenever you pass through Ledetchko.

visits.label: Rovna #1
visits.summary: Pick up the search for the Skalitz priest.

entries.where: A villager in Rovna (tip from the Samopesh innkeeper).
steps: Talk to the Rovna villager who's rebuilding.
He asks you to find the Skalitz priest, Father Simon.

visits.label: Skalitz #1
visits.summary: Back to the ruins: find Father Simon and dig up Kunesh's treasure.

steps: Optional: talk to the family of Father Simon's housekeeper.
Go to the cross and search the area.
Find Father Simon hiding nearby, rescue him and talk to him.
Dig for the treasure under the dove-cote in Skalitz.
Keep the loot for Beran / Kunesh's payoff.
Go back to Rovna and tell the villager what happened to Father Simon.
notes: Finishing this makes In God's Hands easier later.

visits.label: Rattay #2
visits.summary: Out of options — take Peshek's job.

steps: Hand over or settle the treasure business back in Rattay.
Accept Peshek's job.
Learn lockpicking from Peshek.
Get a spade; the hanged man's ring can be dug up, or found hidden in the executioner's house.
Take the ring to the miller in Kohelnitz (Woyzeck).
Optional: pay Peshek back for your treatment.
notes: This opens the millers' Thick as Thieves jobs.

visits.label: Rattay #3
visits.summary: Become a thief with a conscience: Peshek's jobs and the Vagabond's.

entries.where: Miller Peshek at the Rattay Mill — ask him to teach you (after settling your debt).
steps: Go behind the mill with Peshek.
Try to lift his dagger without getting caught.

entries.where: Miller Peshek at the Rattay Mill, after The Good Thief.
steps: First job: steal the ring from the bathhouse madam's chest.
Bring it to Peshek.

entries.display: Rob the Rich, Give to the Poor
steps: Do all the Rattay parts: 50 groschen from the guard Pazdera, 50 from the rich woman, and Wolfram Pruda's silver ring.
Bring each one back to the Vagabond.
notes: Now it fits Henry — steal from the rich to help the Skalitz refugees.

steps: Steal the documents from the Rattay Rathaus.
Steal Sir Hanush's illuminated book from the upper castle.
Bring everything to Peshek.
notes: Hard locks — bring lockpicks and a Padfoot potion.

entries.display: Rob the Rich, Give to the Poor
steps: Steal the guild seal from the Ledetchko merchant.
Bring the seal back to the Vagabond in Rattay.

entries.where: Miller Woyzeck at the Kohelnitz mill, after The Good Thief.
steps: Talk to Miller Woyzeck — you can take all three jobs at once.

visits.label: Talmberg #1
visits.summary: Rob the Talmberg armoury and Lady Stephanie.

steps: Steal at least five waffenrocks from the Talmberg armoury (getting the armoury key helps).
Steal Lady Stephanie's jewellery.
Steal a horse from the Merhojed stables.
Ride it to Woyzeck.
Hand over the waffenrocks and jewellery and ask Woyzeck for your reward.

visits.label: Rattay #4
visits.summary: Pay the Apothecary and look for a trade.

entries.display: Pay the Apothecary and ask to be his apprentice
steps: You should have enough money now — pay the Apothecary what you owe.
notes: Henry wants to be the Apothecary's apprentice, but he's told to learn to read from a scribe in Uzhitz first.

entries.where: The old whore at the Inn at the Glade.
steps: Steal 20 groschen from the customer who didn't pay.
Steal the village woman's woollen shawl.
Steal the farmer's ornamental dagger.
Steal the trunk key from the farmer's wife; return each item to the old whore.

visits.label: Uzhitz #1
visits.summary: Learn to read; find a runaway horse.

entries.where: The head groom at the Uzhitz stables (tip from the Uzhitz innkeeper).
steps: Talk to Vashek the stableboy about the lost stallion, Pie.
Go to the crossroads and find Pie.
Bring Pie back to the stables and collect from the head groom.
notes: A bribe of up to 500 groschen may come up.

entries.where: The Scribe of Uzhitz — ask anyone about learning to read. Bring 50 groschen.
steps: Pay the Scribe of Uzhitz 50 groschen.
Read the book he gives you, then go back to him.
Read the Latin text, then return once more to finish.
notes: Reading is needed for Last Will and Testament and Honeyed Words, and helps a lot in Pestilence.

entries.display: Take alchemy orders from Rattay shops
steps: Brew potions for the shops around Rattay to raise your Alchemy.
notes: Henry can read now, so he's practising alchemy as the Apothecary's would-be apprentice.

visits.label: Ledetchko #3
visits.summary: Kunhuta's ghost problem and the "magic" blacksmith.

entries.where: Kunhuta the herbalist in Ledetchko (tip from the Ledetchko innkeeper).
steps: Talk to Kunhuta the herbalist.
Pick 10 poppies.
Ask Drahomira where Alois is buried.

entries.where: The Ledetchko blacksmith.
steps: The Ledetchko blacksmith wants to know how the Sasau blacksmith makes his "magic" blades.

visits.label: Sasau #1
visits.summary: Big Sasau visit: the monastery, Fritz and Matthew, and lots of errands.

entries.where: Miller Simon at the Sasau mill, after The Good Thief.
steps: Talk to Miller Simon.
First job: steal the valuable brocade from the Sasau tailor and bring it to Simon.

entries.where: Swordsmith Fink at the Sasau forge.
steps: Swordsmith Fink wants the five pieces of the sword (Sasau, Talmberg, two in Rattay, Ledetchko).
notes: Do it at your own pace. Finishing it lets you recruit Fink for Pribyslavitz.

steps: Listen to the Sasau blacksmith's ditty — that's his "magic".
Learn the verses in the right order.

entries.where: The Sasau butcher.
steps: The Sasau butcher wants game and offal. Do it at your own pace (offal needs the Butcher perk).
Pick flowers from the restless dead man's grave.

entries.where: Fritz and Matthew at the Sasau Monastery tavern (tips from the Sasau bailiff and innkeepers).
steps: Find Fritz and Matthew at the monastery tavern.
Hear their troubles; they need work.

entries.where: The farmhand outside the Sasau Monastery.
steps: The farmhand outside the monastery has a series of theft jobs. Do them at your own pace.

entries.where: Matthew, during A Friend In Need... in Sasau.
steps: Find out why Fritz and Matthew owe the monastery money.
Persuade Elias to cancel their debt.
Tell Fritz the good news.

entries.where: Johanka at the Sasau Monastery infirmary (tips from Sasau innkeepers). Timed.
steps: Help Johanka with the sick in the infirmary.
Find something to help the insomniac sleep.
Get healing herbs for Semek.
Find 10 bandages for Hans.
notes: Timed quest — don't wander off for long.

entries.where: Urban, the guard outside the Custodian's house in the Sasau Monastery.
steps: Urban wants a relic of Saint Procopius.
Bring him a "relic", then find a "better" one when he complains.

entries.where: Brother Nicodemus at the Sasau Monastery garden.
steps: Weed Brother Nicodemus's garden and report back.
notes: Happens naturally during In God's Hands.

entries.where: Brother Nicodemus at the Sasau infirmary, after Weeds.
steps: Bring Nicodemus one sample of each herb plus an old book for the herbarium.
notes: Happens naturally during In God's Hands.

steps: Ask Father Simon to help with the sick man at the infirmary.

visits.label: Ledetchko #4
visits.summary: Smudge Drahomira's cottage; report to the blacksmith.

steps: Start the smudging ritual in Drahomira's cottage.
Burn the herbs.
Tell the Ledetchko blacksmith the ditty — the tempering process — in the right order.
Come back the next day to see if the ritual worked. It didn't.

visits.label: Rattay #6
visits.summary: News for Theresa, the Apothecary and Hermann.

steps: Tell Theresa that Matthew and Fritz are alive and looking for work.
Ask the Rattay Apothecary how to get rid of a ghost.
Ask Executioner Hermann how to set the broken leg.
Get Matthew and Fritz work at the Ledetchko mill.

visits.label: Sasau #2
visits.summary: Wrap up the infirmary and steal the Necronomicon.

steps: Tell Fritz and Matthew you found them work.
Set the broken leg, cure Philip, and try to get the Custodian to provide supplies.
Tell Johanka when there's nothing more you can do.
Steal the Necronomicon from the monastery library.
notes: Don't take the torn pages or any other books near the Necronomicon.

visits.label: Rattay #7
visits.summary: Hand over the book; help Elishka.

steps: Give the Apothecary the book and wait until he's read it.

entries.where: Executioner Hermann on Gallows Hill near Rattay (tip from the Broken Wheel innkeeper).
steps: Talk to Hermann about the woman crying outside his house, then to Elishka.
Learn about her husband's family from the scribe (he needs an embrocation).
Find Elishka a home and decide her future with Hermann.
Find something that belonged to Alois, and charred wood from the burnt farm.
Find the grave of Alois's wife, Lada.
Report your findings to the Apothecary.

visits.label: Ledetchko #7
visits.summary: The crossroads ritual; check on the lads.

steps: Meet the Apothecary at the crossroads at the agreed time and take part in the ritual.

entries.where: Fritz and Matthew at their new job, after A Friend In Need...
steps: Check on Fritz and Matthew at the mill and hear both sides of their fight with Old Thomas.
Try to make peace; when that fails, set up a fight with Old Thomas.
Get ready for the ambush, then break the bad news to the lads.

visits.label: Uzhitz #2
visits.summary: Steal a recipe; ask Father Godwin.

steps: Steal the Uzhitz landlord's beer-brewing recipe.
Ask Father Godwin what to do about the ghost.
Get Drahomira to tell the truth.

visits.label: Talmberg #2
visits.summary: Tanner's work and the quarry trouble.

entries.where: Brada the tanner in Talmberg. Needs Hunting 5 and the Tanner perk.
steps: Brada the tanner wants hare, boar and deer hides. Do it at your own pace (needs Hunting 5 and the Tanner perk).

entries.where: Sir Divish in Talmberg (tip from the Talmberg innkeeper).
steps: Talk to Sir Divish about the accident at the monastery.
Talk to the overseer and the master builder.
Find where the bad stone came from.
Meet Leshek and Zmola at the scaffolding after dark; stop Zmola.
Take the skull you find to the knacker.

visits.label: Talmberg #3
visits.summary: Close the quarry case; order a cross.

steps: Report to Sir Divish.
Arrange for a cross to be made for the grave.
Set the cross and finish the ritual. Collect from Kunhuta.

entries.display: Check in on Matthew and Fritz
steps: Visit the lads at the Ledetchko mill.

entries.where: Matthew at the Inn at the Glade (Andrew tips you off).
steps: Talk to Fritz, then make a deal with Andrew.
Get three Cuman disguises: helmets with faceplates and armour from a Cuman camp.
You only need to raid one of the three camps.
notes: Poison the camp in the middle of the night rather than storming it.

visits.label: Talmberg #4
visits.summary: What does a "real" Cuman look like?

steps: Talk to Bran about black (raven) feathers.
Talk to Olena about animal teeth (wolf fangs).
Talk to Vashek about a dog skin.

visits.label: Inn at the Glade #3
visits.summary: Pull off the masquerade; start Andrew's job.

steps: Bring the disguises and trimmings to Matthew and see the plan through.

entries.where: Andrew, innkeeper of the Inn at the Glade, after Masquerade.
steps: Andrew wants to know who looted his Skalitz tavern.
Bring Matthew and Fritz in on it.
Find and talk to Adam — the man who was robbed.
Talk to Tonchek; find the thieving charcoal-burner and rob the stash.
Confront Andrew about the loot.
notes: This causes a falling-out, which is the role-play reason you stay away from the inn for a while.

steps: Return everything to Adam, including his family cross.
notes: Give it all to Adam, not Andrew — this keeps Adam recruitable as Pribyslavitz innkeeper.
Giving the loot to Andrew pays more but loses Adam.

visits.label: Sasau #4
visits.summary: Finish Simon's jobs; take a Cuman to Rattay.

steps: Steal the spurs from the Sasau cobbler and bring them to Simon.

entries.where: The Miller of Budin, who has caught a Cuman (tip from the Ledetchko innkeeper).
steps: Find a translator for the Miller of Budin's Cuman prisoner.
Deal with the Cuman's stash and decide his fate.
Bring the Cuman to Rattay and collect the bounty from the bailiff.
notes: Hand him over alive in Rattay, as the route says.

acts.title: Act III — In Sir Radzig's Service
acts.summary: Henry finally reports for duty and hunts the Neuhof raiders all the way to Pribyslavitz.

visits.label: Rattay #11
visits.summary: Join Radzig, train, compete, and start the hunt for Runt's gang.

entries.where: Starts automatically — Henry wakes at the Rattay Mill.
steps: Settle up at the mill and go to Sir Radzig in the Upper Castle.
spoilers: Sir Radzig takes Henry into his service.

entries.where: Captain Bernard at the Rattay combat arena (north gate).
steps: Report to Captain Bernard at the combat arena.
Learn moving, slashes, stabs, combos, then blocking.
Finish the sparring test.

entries.display: Train all weapon skills to level 5 with Bernard
steps: Spar with Bernard until every weapon skill is at least level 5.

entries.where: The herald in Rattay, on tourney mornings (innkeepers mention it).
steps: Enrol with the herald on a tourney morning.
Fight through the rounds (several weapon types) and win.
Pick up your prize. Repeatable.
entries.reward: Lords of Leipa armour pieces, top weapons
notes: It's tough — train before you enter.

entries.where: Miller Peshek takes bets on the Rattay Tourney.
steps: Bet on yourself with Peshek, then collect your winnings after the tourney. Repeatable.

entries.where: The Samopesh blacksmith, whose son died after winning the tourney.
steps: Find out how Svatopluk, the Samopesh blacksmith's son, died after the tourney.
Tell his father what you learned.

entries.where: Executioner Hermann, some time after Tough Love (Rattay innkeepers send you). Timed — about a week.
steps: Look up the right punishments in the Black Chronicle; ask the bailiff what the convicts did.
Report to Hermann, then sabotage the Kuttenberg executioner (dull the sword, poison the tongs, swap the rope).
Tell Hermann you succeeded and collect your reward.
entries.reward: 400 groschen + recipes, or up to 900 groschen
notes: Timed — Hermann can only stall for about a week.

entries.where: Berthold at the Rattay hunting lodge (tip from the Broken Wheel innkeeper).
steps: Track the three escaped nightingales west of Rattay by their call.
Set traps and catch them.
Bring them to Berthold at the hunting lodge.

entries.where: Sir Hanush after training; report to the watchman Nightingale.
steps: Collect armour at the armoury, then report to Nightingale.
Do the watch duties around Rattay.

entries.where: Think of Theresa after Awakening, or Nightingale nudges you during Keeping the Peace.
steps: First date: see Theresa before noon and walk by the river.
notes: If you're quick, The Prey can be done right after this.

entries.where: Sir Hans Capon in the Upper Castle courtyard, from 5 a.m. (he gives up around 10–11).
steps: Meet Sir Hans in the Upper Castle courtyard (5–10 a.m.) and ride out on the hunt.
Protect him when the hunt goes wrong.
spoilers: Henry saves Hans Capon's life and earns his place in Radzig's service.

entries.where: Captain Bernard, straight after The Prey — he rides to Neuhof without waiting.
steps: Ride with Captain Bernard to Neuhof straight away.
Search the farm and the dead raiders.
spoilers: A bloody hoof pick points to Ginger, the missing stableboy.

entries.where: Starts at Neuhof after the hoof pick is found.
steps: Get Bernard's leave to carry on alone.
Question the charcoal-burners and track Ginger north.
Find Ginger and get the truth from him.
spoilers: Ginger names a limping raider from Uzhitz.

visits.label: Uzhitz #4
visits.summary: The limping man and Father Godwin.

entries.where: Starts after Ginger in a Pickle; go to Uzhitz.
steps: Talk your way in with the Uzhitz bailiff.
Find Father Godwin and follow the trail.
spoilers: The trail leads to Reeky of Ledetchko.
notes: To get to Godwin's party (recommended), threaten him, then back down.

visits.label: Ledetchko #10
visits.summary: Find Reeky before Runt's men do.

entries.where: Starts automatically after Mysterious Ways. Timed.
steps: Ask around Ledetchko about Reeky; talk to his father the tanner and to Adela at the bathhouse.
Track Reeky down before Runt's men do.
spoilers: Reeky points to Timmy near Merhojed.
notes: Timed — if you're slow, Runt's men get to Reeky first.

entries.where: Starts automatically after On the Scent; head to Merhojed.
steps: Go to the windmill south of Merhojed; talk to Timmy's sister Mirka.
Find Timmy and his rival Morcock.
Side with Morcock, but don't kill Timmy yourself.
spoilers: Both leads point to the bandit camp at Pribyslavitz.
notes: Morcock fits the role-play; keeping Timmy's blood off Henry's hands keeps Mirka recruitable as Pribyslavitz barmaid.
Sparing Timmy and siding with him gives a different way into Pribyslavitz.

visits.label: Pribyslavitz #1
visits.summary: Scout and storm the bandit camp.

entries.where: Sir Radzig, after My Friend Timmy.
steps: Scout the camp at Pribyslavitz from the treeline.
Slip inside in Cuman gear — don't rely on Morcock to vouch for you.
Poison the cooking pots and burn the arrow caches.
Report back to Sir Divish.

entries.where: Sir Divish, once you're ready for the attack on Pribyslavitz.
steps: Tell Sir Divish you're ready. Come rested, fed, and with potions.
Fight into the camp, kill the Cuman commander, push to the church.
Hold the position and kill the bandit commander in the steeple.
spoilers: Pribyslavitz falls and a prisoner is taken — the trail now leads to Merhojed.

acts.title: Act IV — Rattay Errands & Talmberg Affairs
acts.summary: Errands for Hanush, the poacher affair, the lads' quarry heist and Lady Stephanie's wedding preparations.

steps: Second date: take Theresa to the Broken Wheel tavern.

entries.where: Captain Bernard at the Rattay combat arena.
steps: Captain Bernard wants the bandit camps around Rattay cleared.

entries.where: The Bailiff of Rattay (tip from the Tavern by the Gate).
steps: Talk to Alex and gather the jobseekers in the Rathaus courtyard.
Match them to the jobs: a cook for Hagen, three water-carriers, two latrine-emptiers.
Get a healing concoction (marigold) for Rock's arm.
notes: Who you give jobs to affects one Queen of Sheba piece and lets you recruit Kornelius as a trader later.

entries.where: Alex, leader of the Skalitz refugees in Rattay.
steps: Alex wants game meat and mushrooms for the refugees. Bring a bow.

entries.where: Sir Hanush (the Rattay bailiff mentions a visiting Vicar).
steps: Talk to Sir Hanush: get rid of the Vicar in Uzhitz.

visits.label: Uzhitz #5
visits.summary: The Vicar, the fisherman and the witches.

steps: Find the Vicar's Waldensian gathering and the owner of the wooden cross.
Persuade Mistress Bauer and her family to flee before the Vicar finds them.
notes: Warn the Bauers. Never hand them to the Vicar; killing him is the last resort and earns nothing.

entries.where: The fisherman east of Uzhitz.
steps: Beat Josef, Maple and Mash, then the fisherman. Fists only.
entries.reward: Double your bet + Agile as a Weasel I
notes: Needed (with the Fight Club) for Revenge of the Cuman King.

entries.where: Father Godwin in Uzhitz (tip from the Uzhitz innkeeper).
steps: Ask Gertrude what she put the village women up to.
Follow the women into the woods at night — from a distance.
Tell Father Godwin how it ended, then tell the herb-woman.
Report to Sir Hanush. Admitting you warned the Bauers costs you the reward.
Bring Alex all the meat and mushrooms.
Clear the four camps, bringing each leader's spurs to Bernard.
notes: Do it straight away — Raiders (Talmberg) and Interlopers (Sasau) are the same kind of job later on.

entries.where: Captain Robard of Talmberg, after Ruin.
steps: Captain Robard wants five Cuman camps destroyed — bring back each leader's faceplate.

entries.where: Nicholas the huntsman in Talmberg (tips from the Uzhitz or Talmberg innkeeper).
steps: Question every villager except Margaret.
Explore the clearing Blacksmith's Betty saw in the woods.
Get the truth from Jake Piper and Thomas.
Question Radan the charcoal-burner.

entries.where: Andrew at the Inn at the Glade.
steps: Learn about Black Lukesh from Andrew.
notes: Andrew's tip-off is the reason you pay him back later with Delicacies.

visits.label: Talmberg #6
visits.summary: Choose a side — then believe Hanekin Hare.

steps: Get deer antlers and Nicholas the huntsman's hunting horn for Black Lukesh.
Question Margaret.
Tell Nicholas everything.
Tell Captain Robard where the poachers are camped, but don't agree to go with him.
notes: Henry won't lead men to slaughter people he's just been drinking with.

steps: Meet the poachers in the clearing.
Your choice there decides which of the two quests fails.
Side with the Talmberg guards.
notes: This fails Sheep in Wolf's Clothing. That's intended.

entries.where: Black Lukesh, one of Hanekin Hare's poachers.
steps: Black Lukesh, one of Hanekin Hare's poachers, wants his stash from his house, which soldiers are watching.
Slip past the watch, grab the stash and bring it to Lukesh within two days.
notes: Trigger timing unverified — if it doesn't appear here, pick it up when offered.
The wiki says Emergency Supply only appears if you sided with the poachers in Sheep in Wolf's Clothing. This route sides with the guards, so it may never trigger. If it doesn't appear, skip it.

entries.where: Hanekin Hare, at the end of Hare Hunt if you believe his story.
steps: Follow Hanekin Hare to his hiding cave.
Believe his story and do the rest: bring Margaret to the mine gallery, get Nicholas to sign the document, give it to Hare.
Agree to become Talmberg's huntsman.
notes: This fails Hare Hunt. That's intended.

steps: Fails automatically once you believe Hanekin Hare in Cherchez la Femme.
notes: Intended — the route trades the guards' version for the truth.

entries.where: The Talmberg chamberlain, after Cherchez la Femme. Needs the Butcher perk.
steps: Talk to the chamberlain. Bring the Talmberg kitchen the game they ask for (needs the Butcher perk).
notes: Game you hunt is no longer counted as stolen.

visits.label: Inn at the Glade #6
visits.summary: Pay Andrew back; the lads' new scheme.

entries.where: Andrew at the Inn at the Glade, after Cherchez la Femme.
steps: Bring Andrew 10 roe deer, 6 hare and 10 boar meat.
notes: This would fit better before Awakening, but it can't start until Cherchez la Femme is done. Treat it as paying Andrew back for the tip about Black Lukesh.

entries.display: A Rock and a Hard Place
entries.where: Matthew at the Inn at the Glade, some time after Besmirched.
steps: Matthew and Fritz want to rob the Talmberg quarry wages.
Agree to help.
notes: Committing a crime against his own lord is out of character for Henry. He goes along hoping to stop a disaster.

entries.where: Andrew at the Inn at the Glade, right after A Rock and a Hard Place starts.
steps: Hear Andrew out — he wants you to tip off Robard.
Don't tell Captain Robard anything, and never finish this quest.
notes: Start it only for the Andrew dialogue. Never complete it — it fails automatically when The Die is Cast begins. Getting the lads arrested also loses them for Pribyslavitz.

visits.label: Talmberg #7
visits.summary: Swap the quarry wages for Henry's own money.

entries.display: A Rock and a Hard Place
steps: Ask Captain Robard about the number of guards at the quarry. When the second option appears, pick "That makes sense".
Help the Talmberg stablemaster with the horses to find out when the money moves.
Swap the wages for your own 3,000 groschen (see below), then give the lads their "loot".
notes: Henry wants to see what Matthew and Fritz are getting into without helping them commit the crime.
Henry hopes to talk them out of it. When they won't budge, he gives them his own money and lies to stop their plan.
PC: drop 3,000 groschen somewhere first, then enter the console command above. Console players: steal the money and put your own 3,000 groschen in its place.

entries.where: Zora at the Neuhof stud farm (Andrew or the Talmberg stablemaster mention it).
steps: Talk to Zora at Neuhof and saddle her dappled grey.
Ride it to the Talmberg stables.
notes: You've probably heard about this from Andrew or the Talmberg stablemaster during A Rock and a Hard Place.

steps: Talk Sir Divish into holding a race; see the stablemaster.
Be at the Talmberg gate at noon the next day on Zora's grey.

entries.where: Sir Divish, during The Sport of Kings.
steps: Collect the ribbons at the dead tree in Uzhitz, the Merhojed mill and the Talmberg quarry.
Race back to the start and win.
notes: After the race, talk to Lady Stephanie. She asks you to come and see her later.

steps: Tell Zora how the race went and return her horse.

entries.where: Lady Stephanie in Talmberg (a guard or the innkeeper sends you).
steps: Lady Stephanie needs wedding gifts: a roan, wine and a decorative crown.
Get a roan from Uzhitz (talking to Vashek helps).
Buy the wine from the Rattay merchant — he wants you to win an archery contest.
Find the missing moldavite for the Sasau masters.

entries.where: The charlatan in Sasau — agree to be his apprentice.
steps: Become the charlatan's apprentice.
Get Procopius's tooth, a branch from the topping-out, the cat's-paw talisman and the burial shroud.
Wait at his place, then hold back the angry crowd.
entries.reward: Bandages, Bowman's Brew, Holy Trinity die

steps: Wait for the moldavite to be set, then collect the decorative crown.

visits.label: Talmberg #10
visits.summary: Deliver gifts; report on the raiders and the hunt.

steps: Ride the roan to Talmberg and hand over the wine and crown.
Hand Robard the faceplates from all five Cuman camps.
Hand in the last game delivery to the chamberlain.

acts.title: Act V — Silver, Plague & Bastards
acts.summary: The investigation moves to Merhojed and the Skalitz mines. Kuno's mercenaries arrive and Pribyslavitz begins to rebuild.

entries.where: Starts when you enter the Upper Castle hall in Rattay after Baptism of Fire.
steps: Enter the Upper Castle hall; get your orders about the prisoner in Merhojed.

entries.where: Sir Radzig, who sends you to Master Tobias Feyfar.
steps: Radzig sends you to Master Tobias Feyfar about the Skalitz silver mine.

visits.label: Merhojed #3
visits.summary: Plague and a dying man's will.

entries.where: Matthias, lying injured in the Merhojed stud farm stables.
steps: Find Matthias in the stud farm stables.
Look carefully at the sick and the village for clues.

entries.where: Vincent of Merhojed, during Pestilence. Henry must be able to read.
steps: Vincent wants his will written down (you need to be able to read).
Update Sir Radzig at his camp near Merhojed.
Ask the monastery's healers for help.
Talk to Elijah about the will.
Give the cure to the sick.
Talk to Vincent again.
Report your progress to Sir Radzig.

entries.where: Sir Radzig, after Baptism of Fire (DLC).
steps: Radzig assigns you to guide Sir Kuno's mercenaries.
Take the will to the Sasau parish priest at St. Martin's.
Talk to the chief engineer; inspect the ore yard, waterworks and shaft.
Find the gallery Master Feyfar described, then escape the mine.

entries.where: Sir Divish in Talmberg, a few days after Baptism of Fire (DLC).
steps: Find Sir Divish's master locator, Marius, at Pribyslavitz.
Join him on his survey.
notes: Better to find the locator on your own — nobody tells Henry about Sir Divish's plans to rebuild Pribyslavitz.

visits.label: Rattay #16
visits.summary: Announcements and a happy ending for Theresa's dates.

steps: Take Marius's letter to the Rattay bailiff and get him to make the announcement.
Report to Tobias Feyfar and the chief engineer.
Third date: hide-and-seek, then help Theresa collect the laundry.
Talk to Theresa after the quest.
notes: You can keep taking Theresa on dates afterwards.

steps: Find Kuno's camp (west of the road between the Rattay Mill and Ledetchko).
Beat Dangler to prove yourself.
Ride out on the first mission in daylight.
notes: The route gives no status here. The quest closes once Bad Blood begins.

entries.where: Sir Kuno at Kuno's camp (west of the road between the Rattay Mill and Ledetchko).
steps: Follow Kuno and his band to the burnt-out farm.
Search the farm, track the raiders and help Kuno wipe them out.
Report to Sir Radzig.

entries.where: Jakey / The Stone at Kuno's camp.
steps: Round 1: get the ring from Dangler.
Round 2: take it to The Stone.

entries.where: Sir Kuno at his camp.
steps: Get Kuno's orders to attack the mill.
Attack the mill with Kuno's band.
Round 3: get Stephan a lullaby potion, or take the ring from The Stone yourself.

entries.where: Sir Kuno at his camp.
steps: Get Kuno's next orders.
Fight your way out with Kuno and the others, then talk to Kuno.
Round 4: take the ring to Jan Bearman.

entries.where: Sir Kuno at his camp.
steps: Jakey has gone missing — ask about him at the Inn at the Glade.
Ask about Jakey, track him from the north edge of the woods, and question him.
Round 5: take the ring to Petr Bearman.

entries.where: Sir Kuno at his camp.
steps: Get ready to face Hagen's men.

visits.label: Merhojed #6
visits.summary: End the plague, the prisoner question, and Kuno's contract.

steps: Defeat Hagen's men and report to Sir Radzig.
Make sure the cure has worked and report.
Question the captive (treat him for the plague first), then report to Radzig at the lookout by Talmberg.
spoilers: The captive's answers point to counterfeit coin.

entries.where: Sir Radzig, at the lookout near Talmberg, after Questions and Answers.
steps: Radzig sends you after the counterfeit money.

acts.title: Act VI — Counterfeiters & the Madonna
acts.summary: Follow the fake coin into Sasau, help Johanka with her visions, and work your way into the Sasau underworld.

steps: Go to the crossroads near Rovna where the counterfeit money changes hands.
Follow the blood trail from the ambushed wagon.
Give Tobias Feyfar the documents the knight was carrying.
Investigate the counterfeiters around Sasau (Zach, Florian, the bathhouse).

entries.where: Baron Sebastian, Custodian of the Sasau Monastery (sent by Robard after Raiders).
steps: Talk to Baron Sebastian, Custodian of the monastery. Kill each camp's leader and bring back proof.

entries.where: Zach at the Sasau Monastery forge, during All that Glisters.
steps: Help Zach humiliate Master Ota (bludgeon duel, or steal the bailiff's armour).
notes: Whoever you side with decides which smith — Zach or Ota — will move to Pribyslavitz.
Happens naturally during All that Glisters.

entries.where: Florian in Sasau, during All that Glisters.
steps: Florian's sweetheart Esther has been kidnapped. Agree to find her.
notes: Happens naturally during All that Glisters.

visits.label: Skalitz #3
visits.summary: Clear the camps and rescue Esther.

steps: Clear all the camps in one trip.
notes: You can do every camp at once, and Damsel in Distress gives you a free fast-travel back to Sasau.

steps: Find where Esther is held, free her and lead her away.
Talk to Esther, then tell Florian.
Question Rapota.
notes: Stash your loot before you question Rapota — he's going to run.

steps: Bring Sebastian the trophies.
Find the counterfeiters' workshop.
notes: Take Ulrich — the scene works better with him, and you fast-travel straight there.

steps: Arrest Jezhek of Ronow.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 1: Infernal Dream
entries.where: Johanka at the Sasau Monastery infirmary.
steps: Johanka tells you about her recurring dream of the Virgin and a cave near Skalitz.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 1: Infernal Dream
steps: Investigate the cave near Skalitz.
notes: Achievement: read about Infernal Justice before you fight the Skalitz soldier.

entries.where: DLC — unlocks through Lost in the Woods.
steps: Become Bailiff of Pribyslavitz and start rebuilding. Do it at your own pace.
notes: Rebuilding a village in a few in-game days is a stretch — a role-play nitpick you can ignore.

entries.where: The Bailiff of Rattay announces you as Bailiff of Pribyslavitz.
steps: Talk to Marius and agree his wage (a Bard potion helps the speech check).
Build the woodcutters' camp, bridge and road, and traders first.

entries.where: Marius at Pribyslavitz, during A Place to Call Home (not shown in the quest log).
steps: Settle one village dispute a day (14 in total). Not shown in the quest log.

entries.where: Marius at Pribyslavitz, during A Place to Call Home.
steps: Pick suppliers for stone, grain, charcoal and livestock.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 1: Infernal Dream
steps: Report what you found in the cave to Johanka.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 2: Casting Lots
entries.where: Johanka, after Chapter 1.
steps: Go with Johanka to the Sasau market for her sermon.
Help Guta get her husband Ambrose, the tailor, to stop gambling.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 3: Go and Sin No More
entries.where: Johanka, after Chapter 2.
steps: Johanka wants Adela, the Ledetchko bathmaid, to help with the sick. Learn First Aid II first if you can.

visits.label: Rattay #18
visits.summary: Capon week: baths, tourney, clothes and a robber baron.

entries.where: Sir Hans Capon, recovering in Rattay after The Prey. Timed — runs until morning.
steps: Join Sir Hans at the bathhouse; play dice with Zdena.
Fetch Sylvan red wine from the Rathaus cellar.
Optional: flowers for Klara.
notes: Postponed until now because Clothes Make the Man needs Questions and Answers done, and it says this happened the night before. Doing it late also gives you more to talk about with Sir Hans.
Give the bouquet to Theresa or Lady Stephanie.
Timed — runs until morning. Bring dice.

entries.where: Sir Hans Capon in Rattay, after Next to Godliness.
steps: Enrol in the tourney on Sir Hans's behalf, then tell him how it went.
notes: Just wait at the tourney ground and pretend it's still the same morning.

entries.where: Sir Hans Capon, after Next to Godliness and Questions and Answers.
steps: Help yourself to clothes from Capon's trunk and go back to Sir Hans.

entries.where: Sir Hanush, after Clothes Make the Man.
steps: Join Bernard's men and find Wolflin's camp (scout both farms).
Parley in Bernard's colours, or fight.
Deal with Wolflin of Kamberg and report to Sir Hanush.

entries.where: Sir Hans Capon in Rattay, after Robber Baron (DLC).
steps: Sir Hans has fallen for Karolina and needs a wingman.

entries.where: Sir Hans Capon, during Honeyed Words (DLC).
steps: Sir Hans has gambled away his family necklace.
Find the dice player who won Sir Hans's necklace.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 3: Go and Sin No More
steps: Get into the bathhouse and convince Adela to leave.
notes: Achievement: read about Voyeur before entering the Ledetchko baths.

visits.label: Sasau #13
visits.summary: Troublemakers, the dice tourney and Pavel's treasure.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 3: Go and Sin No More
steps: Return to Johanka with Adela.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 4: Troublemakers
entries.where: Johanka, after Chapter 3.
steps: Send the Loudmouth's gang away — threaten them with the stocks or fight. Optionally pay to find out who sent them.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 5: Bonum Commune
entries.where: Johanka, after Chapter 4 — meet Pavel of Kolin at the Wagoners' Inn.
steps: Meet the repentant Pavel of Kolin at the Wagoners' Inn.
Find the robber-knight's camp, enter the dice tournament and win back the necklace.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 5: Bonum Commune
steps: Find Pavel's hidden treasure in the ruins west of Sasau (Cumans camp there).
Donate it for the common good: the parish priest, the bailiff, or the monastery.
notes: Achievement: read about Like a Ghost before going into the woods.

steps: Bring the necklace to Capon; slip it and the letter into Karolina's trunk.
Get Musk of Infinite Allure for Sir Hans.

entries.where: The charlatan in Ledetchko, during Honeyed Words (DLC).
steps: Help the Ledetchko charlatan scare the villagers (graves, eggs, meat, water) for the musk recipe.
notes: Or pay 2,000 groschen for the musk.

visits.label: Rattay #20
visits.summary: Hans's big night; the counterfeiting case closes.

steps: Give Hans the potion, follow him to Karolina's, hide, and buy him time.
See him in the morning.
Report to Sir Radzig.
spoilers: The counterfeit trail leads into the Sasau underworld.

visits.label: Sasau #14
visits.summary: Johanka's last sermon; join the crimps.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 6: The Wicket Gate
entries.where: Johanka, after Chapter 5.
steps: Go with Johanka to preach in the meadow; drive off the attackers.
She tells you there's one sinner left: you.
notes: Achievement: if you want Full House Sinner, check its conditions before step 2.

entries.where: Sir Radzig, at the end of All that Glisters.
steps: Find where the crimps meet in Sasau; ask the bailiff, the tanner, the innkeeper, Miller Simon and Thomas at the infirmary.
Join the fight club behind the tanner's house.
Meet the crimps and win their trust.
notes: Join the fight club through the Sasau tanner. If you skip it, Revenge of the Cuman King is locked out.

entries.where: Kozliek of the Sasau crimps, during If You Can't Beat 'em.
steps: Kozliek wants Pious killed — he's hiding in the monastery.
Talk to Karl, the young noble who's about to become a novice (get rid of his guardian first).

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — Ch. 6: The Wicket Gate
steps: Make the pilgrimage to the Church of Uzhitz.
notes: This keeps the bandits, who said they'd be watching, from getting suspicious — they'll think it's part of an initiation trial.

acts.title: Act VII — The Monastery & Vranik
acts.summary: Henry goes undercover as a novice, then into the bandits' camp itself.

steps: Tell Sir Radzig what the bandits want you to do.
Get Karl's writ and go to the monastery gate as a novice.
notes: The route gives no status here; the quest closes when you enter the monastery and A Needle in a Haystack begins.

visits.label: Sasau #15
banners: Shave and reset Henry's hair to the default style before you start A Needle in a Haystack. Most cutscenes from here to the end are pre-rendered.

entries.where: Starts when Henry enters the Sasau Monastery as the novice "Brother Gregor".
steps: Hand your writ to the porter, store your belongings and put on the habit.
Work out which novice is Pious.
notes: Many cutscenes from here on are pre-rendered — shave and reset your hair first if you care about consistency.

entries.where: Novice Antonius, as you enter the Sasau Monastery.
steps: Follow Antonius and keep the monastery timetable: mass, meals, alchemy for Nevlas, copying in the scriptorium, bed.
Find something that would stop Nevlas becoming abbot.

entries.where: Brother Nevlas, during A Needle in a Haystack.
steps: Get the key to the forbidden-books cabinet, steal the book at night and bring it to Nevlas.

entries.where: Brother Librarian, or pick up a torn page in the monastery.
steps: Find all 10 torn pages around the monastery and bring them to the librarian.

entries.where: Inspect the Sasau Monastery cellars.
steps: Find out about the night drinking in the cellars and get the Circators their cask.
Get keys via the prior, or pay Brother Cellarius 200 groschen.

entries.where: Read the Abbot's notes in his study, or via Libri Prohibiti.
steps: Read the novice records in the Abbot's study.

entries.where: Search under a paver in the north room of the monastery dormitory.
steps: Find out who owns the stash under the dormitory paver.

entries.where: Novice Lucas, during Nasty Habits.
steps: Make the Circators stop picking on Novice Lucas, then tell him it's over.
Deal with Pious (killing him or faking it with blood), then take back your things.
spoilers: With Pious dealt with, Henry earns the bandits' trust.

entries.display: The Madonna of Sasau — The Trial
entries.where: Return to the Sasau Monastery after The Wicket Gate.
steps: Talk to the guard in the white brigandine and then Inquisitor Jaroslav.
Do all the optional preparation before the trial for the best outcome.
notes: Achievement: read about Angel of Mercy before you start the trial.

entries.where: Kozliek, after A Needle in a Haystack.
steps: Go to the agreed spot in the swamp by Sasau and light the signal fire.
notes: Point of no return. Once you enter Vranik, several side quests are no longer available. Finish anything you still want first.

steps: Report to Sir Radzig and Sir Hanush.
Scout Vranik's numbers and plans; report to Erik and see Vanyek.
Escape, try to get your gear back, and meet Zbyshek.
spoilers: Henry is found out and has to escape Vranik.

entries.where: Starts automatically back in Rattay after Vranik.
steps: Get your gear back, then report to Bernard and Divish.
Storm Vranik section by section and break the bandits.
Search the homestead and take the letter to Lord Hanush.
spoilers: Vranik falls — but the letter shows the lords have been betrayed.

acts.title: Act VIII — Siege of Talmberg & Epilogue
acts.summary: Talmberg is taken; Henry helps win it back and the story reaches its end.

entries.where: Starts automatically after Payback.
steps: Take the outer bailey and open the portcullis for the reinforcements.
spoilers: Sir Istvan Toth has led the lords into a trap and taken Talmberg.

entries.where: Captain Robard of Talmberg, after Out of the Frying Pan.
steps: See Robard when you're ready; scale the walls and kill the gate guards.
Find Sir Radzig and Lady Stephanie and get out with Sir Hans.

entries.where: Starts automatically after Night Raid.
steps: Talk to Captain Robard, the quartermaster, Sir Divish and Captain Bernard.

entries.where: Master Tobias Feyfar, at the start of Siege.
steps: Tobias Feyfar needs Konrad Kyeser to build a trebuchet.
Find Konrad Kyeser at the monastery building site.
Free him from his contract — for example by forging his commission with the scribe — and send him to Talmberg.
Konrad arrives; the trebuchet work begins.
Wait for the trebuchet to be built.
Get meat and beer for the camp.
Find a priest willing to come to Talmberg, and a physician from the monastery.
Find a herbalist who can brew something to keep the men awake.

entries.where: The Odd Bird in Skalitz. Needs If You Can't Beat 'em (Fight Club), Fishy Business in Uzhitz and Unarmed 8.
steps: Talk to the Odd Bird, beat Asch, then the King of the Cumans (100 groschen per round).
Collect your winnings from the spokesman.
notes: Needs Fishy Business in Uzhitz, the Fight Club from If You Can't Beat 'em, and Unarmed 8.

steps: Go and watch the trebuchet test.

entries.where: Starts automatically once the trebuchet is built.
steps: Ask Sir Divish what your role is, then hold the ford and help Sir Hanush.
spoilers: The enemy strikes first — the battle at the ford decides whether the siege can go on.

entries.where: Starts automatically after Cold Steel, Hot Blood.
steps: Rush to defend the trebuchet, then join the briefing in the tent.
spoilers: A revelation about Henry's own family changes everything.

entries.where: Starts automatically after Family Values.
steps: Fire the trebuchet and wait out the two-day bombardment.
Find the northern, western and eastern encampments.
Storm the walls with Sir Robard.
Ride with Sir Hans to meet your father.
spoilers: Talmberg is taken back.

visits.label: Rattay #23
visits.summary: Get ready for the road ahead.

entries.where: Starts automatically after An Oath is an Oath.
steps: Meet Margrave Jobst in the Upper Castle during the day, then talk to your father.
Tell Sir Hans you need a couple of days to get ready.
Take Theresa on one more date, where the subject of Henry's father comes up.
If From the Ashes isn't finished, do it now: church restored, 40 villagers, 1,200 groschen income.
Report to Sir Divish.
Finish any buildings still open on Marius's list.
notes: Closing entry added so this quest has an end in the guide.

steps: Make sure every supply contract is signed.
notes: Closing entry added so this quest has an end in the guide.

steps: Settle the last of the 14 disputes.
notes: Closing entry added so this quest has an end in the guide.

steps: Pick up Margrave Jobst's letter and follow Capon to the camp.
Talk to Capon to end the game.
spoilers: Henry rides out on a new mission alongside Sir Hans Capon.
